dispute.claim_text: 81 dollars including the toll. He never took the expressway — no gantry, I watched. And he picked someone else up when I paid for a solo ride. The platform refunded half. Other people got a full refund for less. I don't understand the logic.

counterparty_statement.text: Local roads were faster that day. The ERP is part of the fare package; I don't control that line. The other passenger was a short hop, no delay.
